correctness.rationale: Exact binomial-to-weight identity from Kummer and Lucas digit factors; signed 3-state B matrix with B^3=3B+I and initial data; exact recurrence and rational GF. Its real cubic eigenvalues yield kappa>0 and strict exponential spectral gap; aligned cylinder sums are ±e0^T B^(j+1) e_b and hence at most theta^(j+1), giving all-prefix O(X^alpha); X=3^L yields sharpness. The actual standalone checker computed 2600 exact integer binomial residues, all complete 3^L blocks through L=7, and verified both integer matrix identities and recurrences. This finite check does not replace proof.

originality.rationale: The closest exact same-object prior result establishes the nondivisible support of the four-ary Fuss–Catalan numerator at prime three, not its signed unit-residue imbalance. The 2001 general digit-block machinery is a strong enabling antecedent but does not state this cubic signed recurrence, positivity, or sharp exponent. The modulo-five signed result concerns a non-equivalent binomial ray and prime. OEIS tabulates shifted recurrence values without the binomial interpretation or all-prefix sharpness. Actual targeted searches revealed no equivalent theorem. Unindexed specialization and generic-theorem reduction remain residual priority risks.
residual_risks: Barat–Grabner generic block-multiplicative machinery may have an obscure prior exact specialization for the same four-to-one ray.
The signed recurrence already exists in OEIS A188022 under a different interpretation; an unindexed combinatorial identity could have identified the same binomial count.
No independent historical-priority or mathematical audit has been performed.
